name: Ultimate Light Rail
summary: Light rail stations with five platform lengths, underground options and optional approach fences.
description: Ultimate Light Rail 0.12.0 provides one Light Rail Station with four native menu settings: Surface/Underground, Through/Terminus, Platform Length and approach fences. Choose 40, 60, 80, 100 or 120m platforms; 80m remains the default for existing saves. All stations have two platform tracks. Termini always include a scissors crossover; through stations never do. Fences are optional above ground and disabled below ground. Surface through stations have six street access points and a pedestrian underpass. Underground variants reuse native station shells and a street-level entrance, with tracks at 18m depth. The 80m variants were confirmed working in-game; the new lengths require a game test. Native stairs and furniture keep their proportions. Build costs, maintenance and capacity are unchanged in this length update. A separate Light Rail track option adds low metal fences to native tramtrack. Legacy station IDs remain loadable. No automatic rebuilding of existing stations. Use the underground view toolbar for tunnel connections. Do not remove the mod while its infrastructure remains in a save.
